name: Broken Top
label: Broken Top
about_prose: Broken Top is a private, gated golf community on Bend's west side, established in 1992 on land where the high desert meets the foothills of the Cascade Range. The community surrounds an 18-hole championship golf course designed by Tom Weiskopf and Jay Morrish, which opened for play on July 4, 1993.

In October 2019, 84 percent of the community's 645 homeowners voted to purchase the club from Gold Ring Holdings for $6.4 million, transferring ownership to the Broken Top Community Association. The club is now managed by Troon. The 27,000-square-foot clubhouse overlooks a six-acre lake with sightlines to Broken Top, South Sister, and Mt. Bachelor.

Homes range from townhomes to custom estate properties on lots from a fraction of an acre to more than an acre, broadly spanning from under $800,000 to over $3,000,000. The community includes 11 miles of walking and biking paths maintained year-round, minutes from the Old Mill District and the Cascade Lakes Scenic Byway.

amenities.name: 18-Hole Championship Golf Course
amenities.description: Par-72 course playing 7,161 yards from the back tees, rated 73.7 with a slope of 142. Four sets of tees, bent-grass greens, and views of the Cascade peaks.

amenities.name: Golf Performance Center
amenities.description: Opened in 2020. Two covered, heated driving bays with Trackman and GC Quad launch-monitor technology, a short-game area, an 18-hole putting course, and club-fitting services.

amenities.name: Broken Top Restaurant
amenities.description: Full-service restaurant inside the 27,000-square-foot clubhouse, open Wednesday through Sunday with weekend breakfast. Indoor and outdoor dining.

amenities.name: The Lakehouse
amenities.description: Bistro repurposed from the former pro shop, with alfresco dining on a shaded patio and a deck overlooking Charley Berry Lake.

amenities.name: Pickleball Complex
amenities.description: Eight courts built to Professional Pickleball Association standards, added in the 2024 amenity program.

amenities.name: Tennis Courts
amenities.description: Two outdoor tennis courts with an active member community.

amenities.name: Bocce Ball Courts
amenities.description: Two tournament-size artificial-turf courts completed in May 2024 on the sunrise patio.

amenities.name: Six-Acre Lake
amenities.description: Stocked with rainbow trout, with mountain views from the clubhouse deck.

amenities.name: Walking and Biking Paths
amenities.description: 11 miles of private paths maintained year-round throughout the community.

amenities.name: Fitness Center and Yoga Studio
amenities.description: Equipped fitness facility plus a studio offering yoga, pilates, circuit training, and therapeutic movement.

amenities.name: Saltwater Swimming Pool
amenities.description: Heated seasonal outdoor pool used for family events, water aerobics, and swim lanes, with locker rooms, steam rooms, and jacuzzis.

drive_times.note: West side of Bend, just off Mt. Washington Drive
About 22 miles southwest via Century Drive

course_specs.summary: 18-hole private championship course. Rating 73.7, slope 142 from the black tees, four tee options. Bent-grass greens, winter-rye fairways. Practice range, 18-hole putting course, and short-game area on site.
